artifact — transportation? iceboats, minecarts, elytra
creature — trading with villagers, harvesting from animals
enchantment — stat upgrades via effective health and increased damage
battle — honestly I thought that making more creatures in response to battles was really cool. I guess it could be flavored as illager raids or something
